why: OVERWORLD2 (2026-10-11): one full-length demo dungeon for each of the six new overworld themes -- city, great_tree, ice_spire, hill_keep, desert_excavation, night_crater -- for the themes' own tests (tests/test_dungeon_overworld2_themes.py) and for the authors of the proposed dungeons that use them (the Street, the Patriarch, the Dragonspiral, the Field of Swords, the Zero Dig, the Starfall Crater). The same 25-entry shape as tests/fixtures/dungeon_nether_demo.json (entry, a three-way crossroads with a lit, a dark and a flooded way out, a court the ways rejoin in, a maze, a resources room with the theme's ore, a safe room with a healer, a stand, a parkour, a dark room, a collapse bridge, a nest, a mini-boss, a puzzle, a vault, a habitat, an ambush gauntlet, the arena, the exit) with the theme's own Pokemon in the fights; shape_mix on; four variants. A fixture for tests, not a dungeon anyone plays: the real dungeon records are authored in data/dungeons.json later.
